title: Wood Green Emergency Help Points
summary: Emergency facilities, walk-in clinics, and drainage risk points for Wood Green.
content:
For life-threatening emergencies, dial 999 or 112 without delay.

1. Nearest 24-Hour A&E Hospitals:
- North Middlesex University Hospital (24-Hour A&E): Sterling Way, London N18 1QX. From Wood Green station: take bus 144 east along Lordship Lane towards Edmonton (approx. 20-25 mins journey).
- Whittington Hospital (24-Hour A&E): Magdala Avenue, London N19 5NF. From Turnpike Lane station: ~25 min bus ride west via bus 41 along Hornsey Rise to Archway, or walk south to Harringay and head west.
- Royal Free Hospital (24-Hour A&E & Major Trauma Centre nearby): Pond Street, Hampstead, London NW3 2QG. From Bounds Green station: head south on the network or travel via Archway/Hampstead.

2. NHS Urgent Treatment Centres:
- North Middlesex Urgent Treatment Centre: Sterling Way, Edmonton, London N18 1QX. Co-located with the emergency department.
- Finchley Memorial Hospital Walk-In Centre: Granville Road, North Finchley, London N12 0JE. Accessible via North Circular Road west.

3. Local Hazard Notes:
- Moselle Brook Drainage: Culverted sections of the Moselle Brook beneath Lordship Lane and Wood Green High Road cause surface water flash-flooding during severe storms.
- Steep Slopes: Stormwater runoff down from Alexandra Palace hill can pool along Station Road and High Road junctions.

4. Essential Supplies:
Large retail stores and pharmacies along Wood Green High Road, Bury Road, and around The Mall Wood Green maintain emergency supplies, batteries, clean water, and medicines.

Note: addresses and opening hours may have changed — confirm on arrival where possible (verify locally).
